questions.q: EITHER (a) How does Priestley present Sheila as changing? OR (b) How does Priestley use the Inspector to challenge the Birlings?
questions.a: AO1 15, AO2 15. (a) Sheila's early privilege ('pleased with life'); immediate guilt in Act 1; 'they're people'; her challenge to her parents in Act 3. (b) The Inspector's control, the 'one line of enquiry', the photograph, the final speech.
